title: LICHEN L2 disable: propagate LoRa deinit failure
description: Round-3 security review found lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_init.c logs lichen_lora_l2_deinit() failure after stop returns -ECANCELED but later returns success based only on stop_ret. A tx_queue_destroy failure therefore leaves LoRa aborted/terminal while the interface reports successful disable. Preserve and return deinit_ret; translate stop -ECANCELED to success only when deinit succeeded.
acceptance_criteria: Common disable returns deinit failure even when stop returned ECANCELED; returns success for ECANCELED only after successful deinit; lifecycle tests/builds pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
